title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Tariff Note: Order-Size Rates for Home Delivery on Paid-in-Full Programs
content:
On a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order (deposit at order of 100 percent), the home delivery charge starts from a base delivery charge that depends on the order total billed on the order.

**Clause.** An order whose billed total is at least 10 times the program's order minimum is charged the program's home delivery fee plus 15.00 for every full 1000.00 of billed total above 10 times the order minimum; an order whose billed total is below 3 times the program's order minimum is charged 8 percent of the billed total, rounded to the cent and never more than the program's home delivery fee; any other order is charged the program's home delivery fee.

The base delivery charge is the starting amount of the home delivery charge billed on the order.

## Terms used

- **The billed total** is the order total billed on the order, read from its order billing line.
- **A full 1000.00** counts only complete steps of 1000.00 in the excess over 10 times the order minimum; a part step adds nothing.
- The program's order minimum and home delivery fee are the figures of the order's program.

## Marks for the paid-in-full programs

| Program | Order minimum | 10 times the minimum | 3 times the minimum | Home delivery fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 25.00 | 250.00 | 75.00 | 8.99 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 200.00 | 2000.00 | 600.00 | 79.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 50.00 | 500.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Cut-to-Order Flooring orders)

| Billed total | Band | Base delivery charge |
|---|---|---|
| 4350.00 | at least 2000.00; excess 2350.00 holds 2 full steps | 79.00 plus 30.00: 109.00 |
| 3000.00 | at least 2000.00; excess 1000.00 holds 1 full step | 94.00 |
| 2000.00 | at least 2000.00; excess 0.00 | 79.00 |
| 1200.00 | between the marks | 79.00 |
| 599.00 | below 600.00 | 8 percent is 47.92: 47.92 |

**Cap illustration (hypothetical Made-to-Measure Window Coverings order of 100.00).** The billed total is below 150.00; 8 percent is 8.00, which is more than the program's home delivery fee of 0.00, so the base delivery charge is 0.00.
